headlines.title: Russia Frees American Stephen Hubbard After 4-Year Detention
headlines.description: Stephen Hubbard, a 74-year-old retired American teacher from Michigan, is now on his way back to the United States after being detained in a Russian prison for more than four years. Russia accused him of fighting with the Ukrainian military, an allegation his family has always denied. NBC's Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump promises cash and waivers if GOP wins midterms
headlines.description: President Trump is rallying GOP voters in tight races in red states. NBC News’ Monica Alba reports.

headlines.title: Critical vulnerabilities in commonly used web code spark rush to update systems
headlines.description: Crucial vulnerabilities in the PHP language is so severe that global authorities have recommended websites temporarily go offline until it can be fixed.

headlines.title: New York congressional candidate Brad Lander says he was detained by IDF in the occupied West Bank
headlines.description: Congressional candidate Brad Lander said Wednesday in a post on X that he was detained in the occupied West Bank by the Israel Defense Forces while participating in an olive harvest.

headlines.title: Woman sexually assaulted at fraternity near University of Chicago, lawsuit alleges
headlines.description: The new allegations mark the second case of alleged sexual assault to roil the University of Chicago in a matter of days.

headlines.title: Secret Service study explores how to prevent workplace violence
headlines.description: The law enforcement agency best known for protecting the president is using its knowledge to prevent attacks.

headlines.title: Christina Applegate Says She Was Misdiagnosed With MS
headlines.description: For the last five years, Christina Applegate believed she had multiple sclerosis but now she says her doctor told her that she was misdiagnosed. The actor, who has been an outspoken advocate for MS research, said the news was "unnerving" and "confusing." NBC’s Emilie Ikeda reports and Dr. Natalie Azar joins TODAY to discuss what causes a misdiagnosis and how common it is.

headlines.title: Russians locked out of bank accounts and apartments as Ukraine hits data centers
headlines.description: The strikes that took place over several days earlier this month were the first publicized attacks on Russian data centers.

headlines.title: Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton condemns ad featuring her estranged mother
headlines.description: Ohio Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton is condemning a new ad circulating online featuring her estranged mother. NBC News national politics reporter Henry Gomez discusses how close the race between Acton and Republican candidate Vivek Ramaswamy has become in the campaign's final two weeks.

headlines.title: Who is Stephen Hubbard, the retired American teacher freed by Russia?
headlines.description: Stephen James Hubbard, a retired American teacher, was released by Russia on Wednesday after nearly five years in detention in the midst of an apparent warming of ties between Washington and Moscow.
